reference.title: Barbell Clean and Press

breathing.pattern: Brace before the bar leaves the floor and hold it through the clean; take a breath in the rack, brace, breathe out as the bar passes the forehead; breathe in at the top or back in the rack.
breathing.cadence: Clean about 1.5 s, stand, press about 1 s, lower about 1 s to the rack, then to the floor

prescription.tempo: Explosive clean, controlled press and lowering
prescription.load: Barbell load is user-chosen and limited by the press: a weight you can press strictly for every rep (about 2 reps in reserve).
prescription.progression: Add 2.5 kg when every clean is caught cleanly in the rack and every press is strict.

cues.text: Bar over mid-foot, feet hip width, overhand grip just outside the shoulders, shins to the bar, hips above the knees, back flat, brace.
Push the floor away: the bar rises close to the shins, the back angle holds until the bar passes the knees.
From mid-thigh, jump: hips, knees and ankles extend hard, shrug, elbows high and out; then pull under, whip the elbows round and catch the bar at the front of the shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall with the bar at the front of the shoulders, palms forward, forearms under the bar: the press start.
Squeeze the glutes, head back slightly, press the bar straight up past the face, then bring the head through so the bar finishes over the middle of the foot, arms straight.
Lower the bar to the shoulders, bring it down in front of the chest and waist to the thighs, then lower it to the floor with a flat back, like a deadlift.

mistakes.fix: Arms stay long until the hips and legs have extended; the arms only guide the bar under.
Keep it close to the thighs and the body all the way up.

mistakes.mistake: Catching the bar out in front
mistakes.fix: Pull yourself under fast and get the elbows round so the bar lands at the shoulders, close to the body.
Squeeze the glutes and abs; only the head moves back to clear the bar.

mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back when lowering to the floor
mistakes.fix: Hinge with a flat back as in a deadlift.

kinematics.setup: Plates on the floor; knees ≈78°, hip channel ≈138°, trunk ≈65° from vertical
kinematics.peak: Mid-thigh after the first pull: knees ≈19°, trunk ≈31°
kinematics.norm: Clean start like a deadlift: hips above the knees, shoulders over or just in front of the bar (NSCA, Caulfield, Hornsby & Haff)

kinematics.setup: Second pull on the balls of the feet, bar to the lower chest with the elbows high
kinematics.peak: Quarter squat, knees ≈50°; bar on the front of the shoulders, elbows ≈26° from the trunk line
kinematics.norm: Power clean caught in a quarter squat with the bar on the front of the shoulders (NSCA); the mid-thigh / hang start produces high power output (Suchomel 2014)

kinematics.setup: Rack: bar 23 cm in front of the shoulder joints, elbows ≈132°
kinematics.peak: Overhead: upper arm ≈165° from the trunk line, elbows ≈8°, bar -1.5 cm from mid-foot
kinematics.norm: Strict press from the rack to straight arms overhead, bar over mid-foot (common coaching)

kinematics.setup: Overhand, 58 cm between the handle centres
kinematics.norm: Overhand, just outside the shoulders, held the whole rep (NSCA)

kinematics.setup: Set 0.8 s, first pull 0.8 s, jump and catch 0.5 s
kinematics.peak: Press 1 s, lockout 0.4 s, down to the floor 3.8 s
kinematics.norm: Explosive clean, controlled press and lowering (clinical opinion)

cautions: Learn the clean from a coach and from the hang with an empty bar before pulling from the floor.
Clear space all round; drop the bar forward and step back if a lift goes wrong (bumper plates on a platform).
Shoulder pain overhead or wrist pain in the rack: use a dumbbell version or a hang clean only.
Low-back pain: start from blocks or the hang.
Stop if sharp pain, numbness, tingling or giving-way occurs.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
modify: From the hang (bar at the thighs) to shorten the pull.
Push press if the strict press is the limit.
regressions: Hang power clean plus a separate overhead press.

muscleNotes.glute_max_r: Explosive hip extension in the second pull (NSCA).
muscleNotes.glute_max_l: Explosive hip extension in the second pull (NSCA).
muscleNotes.quads_r: Extend the knees off the floor and stand the catch up.
muscleNotes.quads_l: Extend the knees off the floor and stand the catch up.
muscleNotes.hamstrings_r: Hip extension from the floor to the jump.
muscleNotes.hamstrings_l: Hip extension from the floor to the jump.
muscleNotes.upper_traps_r: Shrug in the second pull; upward rotation overhead.
muscleNotes.upper_traps_l: Shrug in the second pull; upward rotation overhead.
muscleNotes.triceps_r: Straighten the elbows to lock the press out.
muscleNotes.triceps_l: Straighten the elbows to lock the press out.
muscleNotes.calves_r: Extend the ankles in the jump.
muscleNotes.calves_l: Extend the ankles in the jump.
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_r: Hold the back flat from the floor (Escamilla 2002).
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_l: Hold the back flat from the floor (Escamilla 2002).
muscleNotes.core: Brace the trunk in the catch and under the bar overhead.
muscleNotes.serratus_r: Rotates the shoulder blades upward overhead.
muscleNotes.serratus_l: Rotates the shoulder blades upward overhead.
muscleNotes.rhomboids_midtrap_r: Keep the upper back set in the pull.
muscleNotes.rhomboids_midtrap_l: Keep the upper back set in the pull.
muscleNotes.biceps_r: Guide the bar in the turnover.
muscleNotes.biceps_l: Guide the bar in the turnover.
